grammar.evidence: R1 Check Up: fix / can · R2 Check Up: don’t have to · WB GRAMMAR TEST A(can’t·Can·must·have to) B(지불할 필요가 없다·주차해서는 안 된다·쓸 수 없다) C(don’t have to wait·must[have to] follow·can speak)

quiz.q: He ____ fix the computer. He is good at it. (~할 수 있다, 1단어)
You ____ wait for her. She is already here. (~할 필요가 없다, 3단어)
You ____ park here. It’s not allowed. (must 이용, 2단어)
She ____ carry her passport. (have to를 알맞은 형태로)
The Wi-Fi is free. You (don’t have to / must not) pay for it.
She musts follow the school rules.
quiz.a: She must follow the school rules.
